SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM V_VOC_ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE='KRKORE0001' AND TYPE='C001' AND CODE=X.DS_DEPT AND SYS_TYPE='KA') DS_DEPT_NAME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = X.DS_USER_ID AND SYS_TYPE='KA') AS DS_USER_NAME, X.TOT_CNT, X.CLAIM_CNT, X.SIMPLE_CNT, X.CLT_CNT, X.NOT_CNT, X.DS_DEPT, X.DS_USER_ID FROM ( SELECT A.DS_DEPT AS DS_DEPT, A.DS_USER_ID AS DS_USER_ID, COUNT(VC_NO) AS TOT_CNT, COUNT((SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE CODE = A.CLAIM_TYPE AND TEXT3 = 'C')) AS CLAIM_CNT, COUNT((SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE CODE = A.CLAIM_TYPE AND TEXT3 = 'S')) AS SIMPLE_CNT, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'PA',1,'FB',1,0)),0) AS CLT_CNT, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'DC',1,'PS',1,0)),0) AS NOT_CNT FROM KEPAVCDT A
WHERE 1=1
WHERE TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{st_fromDate} AND #{st_toDate}
AND A.DS_DEPT IN (#{st_ds_dept_code})
AND A.DS_USER_ID IN (#{st_ds_user_id})
GROUP BY A.DS_DEPT, A.DS_USER_ID ) X ORDER BY 1, 2
